user_query: I want to organize a basketball tournament in my community and I need a list of all the players participating. Can you provide me with the player list for this season? Additionally, I would like to know the latest player events by player ID for the tournament's star player.

TaskList.description: 查询本赛季所有参赛球员的名单
获取特定球员（明星球员）的最新比赛或活动信息
